papers.title: Preliminary investigation on selective laser melting of Ti-5Al-2.5Sn α-Ti alloy: From single tracks to bulk 3D components

corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Optical and Electronic Information, Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究α钛合金的选择性激光熔化工艺，未涉及多孔结构或应力屏蔽分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on process parameter optimization for SLM of Ti-5Al-2.5Sn alloy, but does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.method: 从单道扫描优化至块体成形参数
summary_zh.result: 成功制备致密块体并测试力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of selective laser melting of Ti-5Al-2.5Sn α-Ti alloy.
summary_en.method: Process parameters were optimized from single tracks to bulk 3D components.
summary_en.result: Dense bulk components were successfully fabricated with good mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and single-track experiments validated the process.
